SECURITY.TITLE: Security
SECURITY.INTRO: How you sign in to Monkey and how you get back in if you lose your phone.

PASSWORD.TITLE: Password
PASSWORD.INTRO: To change it you need your current password and a code from your authenticator app.
PASSWORD.FORGOT_HINT: Don't remember it? Recover it by email
PASSWORD.DONE: Your password was changed. We signed out your other sessions and notified you by email.
PASSWORD.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not change the password. Try again.
PASSWORD.CONFIRM_BODY: Enter the code from your authenticator app to change your password.

NOTES.SESSIONS: When you change it, we sign out your other open sessions; this one stays active.
NOTES.REUSE: You cannot reuse the current one or one of the last 5.
NOTES.LIMIT: You can change it up to 3 times a day.
NOTES.TITLE: Keep in mind

RECOVER.TITLE: We sent you an email
RECOVER.BODY: We sent a link to create your new password to:
RECOVER.HINT: It expires in 30 minutes. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.
RECOVER.ERROR: We could not send the email. Try again.

RECOVERY.TITLE: Recovery codes
RECOVERY.INTRO: They let you sign in if you lose the phone with your authenticator app. Each one works once. Generating new codes invalidates the previous ones.
RECOVERY.SHOWN_ONCE: Save them now in a safe place: they will not be shown again.
RECOVERY.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not generate the codes. Try again.
RECOVERY.IDLE_HELP: They are shown only once: keep them somewhere safe.
RECOVERY.CONFIRM_BODY: Enter the code from your authenticator app to generate new recovery codes.

ROWS.PASSWORD_DESC: Change the password you use to sign in.
ROWS.MFA_APP_DESC: Use one-time codes from your authenticator app to confirm it is you.
ROWS.RECOVERY_DESC: Generate new codes to sign in if you lose your phone.
ROWS.DEVICES_DESC: Browsers where we only ask for your password.

DEVICES.TITLE: Remembered devices
DEVICES.INTRO: On these browsers we only ask for your password, not the code from your authenticator app. They are remembered for 30 days.
DEVICES.NAME: {{browser}} on {{os}}
DEVICES.CONFIRM_ONE_BODY: The next time someone signs in from that browser, the code from your authenticator app will be requested.
DEVICES.CONFIRM_CURRENT_BODY: This is the browser you are using. Your session stays open, but the next time you sign in the code from your authenticator app will be requested.
DEVICES.CONFIRM_ALL_BODY: On all your browsers, the code from your authenticator app will be requested the next time you sign in.
DEVICES.FORGOTTEN_CURRENT: The next time you sign in, the code from your authenticator app will be requested.
DEVICES.ERROR_TITLE: We could not forget the device
DEVICES.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load your remembered devices.
DEVICES.EMPTY_BODY: When you sign in, tick “Remember this device for 30 days” next to the code from your authenticator app and it will show up here.
